result.summary: Found 2 visual usability issues: the fixed bottom navigation obscures feed content, and horizontally scrolling rows are visibly clipped without a clear scrolling affordance.

issues.description: The next restaurant card in the "Popular right now" feed extends behind the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its image/content partially hidden and difficult to view or tap.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scrollable content so the final visible cards clear the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category row and "Fastest near you" restaurant carousel cut off items at the right edge (for example, the partial category pill and truncated "Trattoria Piccol..." card) without an obvious horizontal-scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Provide a clearer carousel affordance, such as a fade/gradient edge, partial-card spacing, swipe hint, or pagination indicator; ensure clipped labels are intentional and readable when scrolled.
